subject.title: Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Board, Area 2

text: Age: 52
Occupation: Teacher
Nancy Loera has nearly 25 years of experience as a teacher and serves as the Hacienda La Puente USD Trustee for Area 2.
As a parent whose children attended HLPUSD schools, Nancy understands the importance of providing every student with a high-quality education.
Nancy is focused on keeping reading, writing, and mathematics at the center of every decision so students are prepared for college, careers, and life.
Working alongside educators, staff, and the community, Nancy:
Advocated for stronger reading and mathematics programs at Lassalette Elementary, where students are thriving.
Supported the Dual Language Program at Nelson Elementary.
Expanded music funding for La Puente HS.
Supported arts and enrichment at California Elementary and Sparks Middle through music, Youth Cinema Project, District Musical, and Mariachi.
Supported educational opportunities requested by the community: Aviation, Drones, Robotics, C-STEM, Speech and Debate, and Conga Kids.
Believes every student deserves a safe, supportive learning environment.
Supported difficult financial decisions that helped keep HLPUSD financially stable while protecting educational opportunities for students.

Nancy believes taxpayer dollars should be spent responsibly, focused on students, and educational opportunities. She respectfully asks for your vote to continue delivering responsible leadership, putting students first, and expanding opportunities for all students.
www.NancyLoera.net

text: As a working mother, parent, and now grandparent, I understand the hopes and challenges families face every day. Balancing work while raising my children taught me responsibility, perseverance, compassion, and how to make thoughtful decisions under pressure. Today, as the grandmother of a grandson on the autism spectrum, I also understand the importance of ensuring students with special needs receive the support and opportunities they deserve to thrive.

During my 40 year career in transportation, hospitality, and travel—including aviation, Amtrak, and May Company Travel—I built strong skills in teamwork, customer service. Managing travel operations for 45 stores required organization, and the ability to work collaboratively. As a proud Transportation Union member, I successfully fought an unjust termination, reinforcing my belief in fairness, accountability, and standing up for others. Throughout my career, I challenged myself to keep learning.

Every child deserves a high-quality education, safe schools, and access to the resources they need to succeed. My lived experience as a working mother, grandmother, and community advocate, combined with my professional background in listening, conflict resolution, and collaboration, has prepared me to work with the Board of Education, educators, families, and our community to ensure every student has the opportunity to reach their full potential.

text: Age: 43
Occupation: Teacher/School Administrator
For the past 14 years, La Puente has been my home. It is a community I care deeply about and one I am proud to serve.

As a teacher, school administrator, and former La Puente Planning Commissioner, I've spent my career helping young people discover their potential and helping organizations succeed through thoughtful leadership and collaboration. I've learned that the best decisions are made when people listen, treat one another with respect, and stay focused on the work that matters.

I believe every child deserves an outstanding education that includes strong academics, excellent teachers, safe schools, and meaningful opportunities in STEM and the arts. Education should prepare students not only for college and careers, but for lives of purpose and contribution.
I'm running because our students deserve a Board that is focused on education, works together with civility and respect, and earns the trust of our community.
I would be honored to earn your vote for Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2.
